reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Maintaining HIV low prevalence in Mongolia through the National Prevention, Care, Treatment and Support Programs on HIV/AIDS - Mongolia (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Mongolia, HIV, Ministry of Health of Mongolia (MOH Mongolia)This program has the following goals: To reduce STI prevalence by 30% and reach 90% of HIV case finding by 2020. The objectives of this program are: To reduce HIV prevalence among MSM from 12% to 7% by 2020.. To improve condom use among FSWs from 83% to 90% by 2020.. To maintain high level (95%) of survival among adults and children living with HIV
